verdict.rationale: PostHog documents a public API: the API docs cover scoped OAuth access instead of personal API keys, and a probe confirmed a published OpenAPI spec at posthog.com/openapi.json. The docs also say flags and experiments can be managed programmatically from your own tooling and CI. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving the product through the API, and detailed endpoint coverage evidence beyond the spec's existence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: OAuth lets users grant your app scoped access without sharing their personal API key.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://posthog.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Evaluate flags at runtime and manage flag definitions from your own tooling and CI.
Manage experiments, holdouts, and shared metrics programmatically from your own systems.
